name: The Last Umbrella – Episode 1
description: A stranger offers a soaked office worker the last umbrella at a bus stop – then reveals he knows her name.

nodes.label: Style
nodes.text: Plain, realistic TV-drama look: overcast evening light, wet streets, true-to-life skin texture, muted colours, handheld 35mm, no glamour lighting.

nodes.label: Mai – sheet
nodes.prompt: Character reference sheet of one person, Mai: Vietnamese woman, late 20s, shoulder-length black hair, light grey blazer over a white blouse, black trousers, canvas tote bag. Left, a head-and-shoulders close-up looking into the lens; right, full-body front, side and back views standing relaxed. Identical face, hair and outfit in every view, plain light grey background, even studio light, photorealistic, no text, no labels.

nodes.prompt: Character reference sheet of one person, Khoa: Vietnamese man, early 30s, short neat hair, dark navy raincoat, carries a closed black umbrella. Left, a head-and-shoulders close-up looking into the lens; right, full-body front, side and back views standing relaxed. Identical face, hair and outfit in every view, plain light grey background, even studio light, photorealistic, no text, no labels.

nodes.label: a city bus stop at dusk – set
nodes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a city bus stop at dusk, no people: glass shelter with a metal bench, rain streaming off the roof, traffic lights blurred in the background. @style

nodes.label: s01 – still
nodes.prompt: Film still, medium shot in @busstop_set. Mai stands at the edge of the shelter, hair wet, holding her tote over her head. Mai looks exactly like @mai_sheet. @style

nodes.label: s01 – clip
nodes.prompt:
Starting exactly from @s01_still, one continuous shot, no cuts.
0–1.5 s: hold on the opening frame, small natural movement only.
She checks her phone, sighs and looks up the road for the bus.
Last 2 s: hold the final pose so the clip can be trimmed.
Camera: steady, slight handheld drift.
No on-screen text, no subtitles, no music.

nodes.label: s02 – still
nodes.prompt: Film still, two-shot in @busstop_set. Khoa steps under the shelter beside Mai, rain dripping from his coat. Mai looks exactly like @mai_sheet. Khoa looks exactly like @khoa_sheet. @style

nodes.label: s02 – clip
nodes.prompt:
Starting exactly from @s02_still, one continuous shot, no cuts.
0–1.5 s: hold on the opening frame, small natural movement only.
Khoa holds out the closed umbrella to Mai without a word. Khoa says once, starting at 0.3 s, in one breath: "Take it. It's the last one." – then stays silent.
Last 2 s: hold the final pose so the clip can be trimmed.
Camera: steady, slight handheld drift.
No on-screen text, no subtitles, no music.

nodes.label: s03 – clip
nodes.prompt:
Starting exactly from @s03_start, one continuous shot, no cuts.
0–1.5 s: hold on the opening frame, small natural movement only.
Mai hesitates, then takes the umbrella; Khoa smiles and steps back into the rain. Khoa says once, starting at 0.3 s, in one breath: "Goodnight, Mai." – then stays silent.
Last 2 s: hold the final pose so the clip can be trimmed.
Camera: steady, slight handheld drift.
No on-screen text, no subtitles, no music.

nodes.prompt:
Starting exactly from @s04_still, one continuous shot, no cuts.

Her eyes widen as she realises she never told him her name.
Last 2 s: hold the final pose so the clip can be trimmed.
